---
title: Generic font family
brand: _brand.yml
format:
  mcanouil-typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: A user brand whose base font family is only a CSS generic family keeps the preset family in Typst, so the render does not stop on an empty font list.
    mcanouil-typst:
      noErrorsOrWarnings: true
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - ['base: \("Source Serif 4", \)']
